diagnostics.title: Syntax semicolon is forbidden
diagnostics.fix: Remove the token or apply the grammar-specific structural replacement.

diagnostics.title: Ambiguous or incomplete continuation
diagnostics.fix: Complete the expression or format the continuation unambiguously.

diagnostics.title: Required expression must start on the same line
diagnostics.fix: Move the first expression token beside return/throw/yield or open a parenthesized expression.

diagnostics.title: Invalid basic-for separators
diagnostics.fix: Use two top-level colons; retain nested conditional colons.

diagnostics.title: Invalid resource separator
diagnostics.fix: Place each complete resource on its own logical line.

diagnostics.title: Invalid enum member boundary
diagnostics.fix: Use one top-level colon between constants and members.

diagnostics.title: Inferred local requires an initializer
diagnostics.fix: Add a typed initializer or use an explicit type.

diagnostics.title: Cannot infer from null or untargeted functional expression
diagnostics.fix: Provide a cast/target type or explicit declaration type.

diagnostics.title: var/val is not allowed in this declaration context
diagnostics.fix: Use an explicit field, parameter, or return type.

diagnostics.title: Cannot reassign val
diagnostics.fix: Remove reassignment or declare the local with var/explicit non-final type.

diagnostics.title: Duplicate accessor
diagnostics.fix: Keep at most one getter and one setter.

diagnostics.title: Property operation is unavailable
diagnostics.fix: Add an accessible accessor or stop reading/writing the property.

diagnostics.title: Final property cannot have a setter
diagnostics.fix: Remove final or the setter.

diagnostics.title: Computed property has invalid storage requirement/modifier
diagnostics.fix: Remove storage-only modifier or define valid storage.

diagnostics.title: Backing storage or generated accessor collision
diagnostics.fix: Rename the source member or conflicting explicit declaration.

diagnostics.title: field is unavailable in this accessor context
diagnostics.fix: Use field only where the current property has backing storage.

diagnostics.title: Annotation target is invalid for generated member
diagnostics.fix: Place the annotation on a compatible field/accessor/parameter target.

diagnostics.title: Incompatible property metadata version
diagnostics.fix: Recompile the dependency with a supported Javelle metadata schema.

diagnostics.title: Unsupported target-release feature
diagnostics.fix: Raise --release or rewrite using supported Java semantics.

diagnostics.title: Compilation/processor rounds did not converge
diagnostics.fix: Remove cyclic or duplicate generation and inspect related round diagnostics.
